tags.description: Rainwave REST-ish endpoints for core Rainwave interactivity, as used on the website.
tags.name: Core

tags.description: Endpoints that begin websocket connections for Rainwave, or are related to maintaining Websocket status.
tags.name: Websocket

sort.description: How to sort the songs that are a part of the album.

post.description: Returns all albums on the station, sorted by album ID.

sched_id.description: The last timeline entry sched_id you have seen.

order.description: A comma-separated list of Song IDs that represent the user's request queue, in the order the user desires.

get.description: Upgrades HTTP connection to a WebSocket session for the station.

_album_art.description: Base album art URL for Rainwave. Usage: `art = album_art ? "https://rainwave.cc/${albumArt}_320.jpg" : "https://rainwave.cc/static/images4/noart_1.jpg"`

_election_song_type.description: 2 for normal song, 4 for request.  Other numbers are no longer used.

_all_songs_for_artist.description: all_songs[station_id][album_id] = [song1, song2, ...] - for song names, inspect song.album[0].name.

pongConfirm.description: This API component had a mistake made: it is not snake-cased, but it should have been.  It will not be fixed.

redownload_m3u.description: This API event occurs when a user who is logged in tunes in without using their listener key. This prompts them to tune in again in order to obtain the correct M3U.

good.description: Does the song still exist on the Rainwave?

valid.description: Does the song still exist on the station of the API request?
